title: Case 007: International Transfer Status
initial_request: I can see that H&V recorded my international transfer as sent, but I cannot tell what stage it has reached. Please check its current status and tell me whether receipt by the beneficiary has been confirmed.
overview: Mara Ellwood asked H&V to clarify the progress of an international transfer after the secure portal showed it as sent. The agent escalated the request to H&V's Payment Team for an available trace. H&V's trace showed the instruction sent onward from H&V, with downstream status still pending; receipt by the beneficiary was not confirmed.

next_action.summary: The agent asked H&V's Payment Team to check the available trace for case HV-007 and report the current stage.

outcome: H&V's trace showed the transfer instruction sent onward from H&V, with downstream status pending. Whether the beneficiary received it remains unknown.

events.body: H&V has recorded your international payment instruction as sent.
I can see the sent status, but I need to know what stage the transfer has reached. Can you check whether there is confirmation that the beneficiary received it?
Please check the available trace for case HV-007 and tell me the current recorded stage. Please distinguish H&V's status from any confirmation of receipt by the beneficiary.
Our current trace shows the instruction sent onward from H&V. The downstream processing status is pending, and our trace does not confirm receipt by the beneficiary.
I checked the available H&V trace. It shows your instruction sent onward from H&V, with downstream processing status pending; we do not have confirmation that the beneficiary received it.
